title: Lameness
summary: LA'MENESS, noun 1. An impaired state of the body or limbs; loss of natural soundness and strength by a wound or by disease; particularly applied to the limbs, and implying a total or partial inability

inlines.v: LA'MENESS, noun 1. An impaired state of the body or limbs; loss of natural soundness and strength by a wound or by disease; particularly applied to the limbs, and implying a total or partial inability; as the lameness of the leg or arm. 2. Imperfection; weakness; as the lameness of an argument or of a description.
